### Possible future reads

- [Attention Is All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762) by Vaswani et al.

- [Hypothesis Testing with E-values](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.23614) by Ramdas and Wang

- [Generalized universal inference on risk minimizers](https://academic.oup.com/jrsssb/article/88/3/756/8284721) by Dey, Martin, and Williams

- [Time-uniform central limit theory with applications to anytime-valid causal inference](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2103.06476) by Waudby-Smith et al.

- [Reflection couplings and contraction rates for diffusions](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1305.1233) by Eberle and/or earlier work on couplings by Mu-Fa Chen, Feng-Yu Wang and company
